name: assethub
description: Local structured-data storage: records are folders (record.json plus attachments) under project namespaces, validated by schemas, browsed in a read-only web page.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs && node -e "require('node:fs').chmodSync('dist/cli.js', 0o755)"
scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/cli.js demo --data-dir .demo
